Definition: to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask
BiblicalUsage: 1) to seek out, swell, cause to swell, boil up, enquire; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to seek, enquire; 1a2) to cause to boil up; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be searched out; 1b2) to be swelling, bulging, swelling out
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
